notes.title: DLC Retro Synthwave aka ’80s
notes.content:
The new DLC Retro Synthwave will be released tomorrow (19 May 2021).

If your goal is to create Synthwave, Synthpop, Retrowave, Vapourwave, Chillwave and other similar genres, then with this DLC, Rytmik Studio will be just the tool to let you do it.

[list]
[*] Over 250 authentic samples created and selected specially for synthwave
[*] ’80s Drums
[*] Electronic percussion
[*] Classic synthesizer bass
[*] Wide selection of melodic and accompanying synthetic instruments
[*] New "Tape" master effect–simulating magnetic tape sound to instantly give your track the appropriate retro feel
[*] 9 new unlocked demo songs
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552100/Retro_Synthwave/

In the meantime, you can listen two of the nine demosongs.

notes.title: New DLC for Game Developers and Video Creators
notes.content:
Imagine you have a rich set of sounds, jingles and music pieces within reach which you can use in your games, music videos, trailers, advertisements or your streams. Royalty free. Available inside a robust music software. Mega Pack for [b]Rytmik Studio[/b] is precisely like this.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/928580/Rytmik_Studio__MEGA_PACK_Games__Videos/

This DLC for [b]Rytmik Studio[/b] is offering hundreds of jingles, sounds and music pieces instantly usable in your games and videos. You can access all this content through three tracks included in this DLC. 

[list]
[*]The first track offers ready-made sound effect perfect for any arcade game or animation. (170 Ready-made Fx Sounds)
[*]The second track is all about jingles. Do you need win, loose or death sound? We are ready for this. (136 Jingles)
[*]The third track offers short music pieces with various kinds of moods. Positive, negative, happy, fast, slow, atmospheric - we got all your needs covered. (84 Music Pieces)
[/list]

Everything we are offering you is based on instrumental bank which is an integral part of Rytmik Studio. You can use jingle, music piece or sound effect as you like without or with further modification. We don’t care as long as your players and viewers are happy. But to be honest, we hope you play with our presets and create and share your creations with the community. It’s straightforward and fun to create something unique and original.

[h1]FREE BONUS[/h1]
This DLC also include tracks from [b]Rytmik Ultimate – CHIPTUNE PACK: Games & Videos[/b]. Additional 100 fx sounds, 60 jingles, 120 moods and music pieces.

[h1]Copyright & Licensing Terms[/h1]

You are welcome to use all the content in this DLC for commercial use in your games, videos, advertisements, just anything. Please don't resell our content and credit us as follows:

All our content is composed exclusively by us, CINEMAX, s.r.o. You cannot state that you own our content, or that anyone else owns it, or that you or anyone else has the rights to use it, or that you composed it and/or performed it.

notes.title: Version 0.72.2.b80524 – Steel drum & Bagpipes
notes.content:
Version 0.72.2.b80524 – Steel drum & Bagpipes
[list]
[*]NEW: audio buffer size can be set up to 32768 (simmilar to previous Large buffer setting). Use higher buffer sizes to avoid audio dropouts on machines with slower CPU.
[*]NEW: Added Samples of Steel drum to WORLD/MALLET bank. Added two Steel drum presets.
[*]NEW: Added Samples of Bagpipes to WORLD/BOWWIND bank. Added two Bagpipes presets.
[*]FIXED: Several bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
notes.content:
Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
[list]
[*]NEW: Sound engine is reworked to achieve much lower latency. Buffer size 4096 is equivalent to previous LOW buffer setting. Buffer sizes 1024 and lower should be usable for live recording.
[*]NEW: Live recording in Clip editor. With lower audio buffers it is possible to live record notes from MIDI or PC keyboard.
[*]NEW: Metronome. It is possible to use metronome in Clip editor for live recording.
[*]NEW: Over 100 new instrument presets.
[*]FIXED: Several bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.content:
Two weeks have passed since the first public release. Rytmik Studio v0.21.1.b71128 is now available.

[b]Version 0.21.1.b71128 - TOOLTIPS![/b]
[list]
[*]NEW: TOOLTIPS! Enable/Disable by F1 or by "?" button
[*]NEW: Names of Suporters added to Credits
[*]NEW: Note Insert Skip setting - you can set how many beats will note cursor auto-advance after inserting the note by keyboard (both midi or PC).
[*]FIXED: New song has global reverb and delay fx volume set to 50% instead 100%. This fixes too much reverb and delay in presets and results in better reverb and delay setting.
[*]FIXED: There was a bug when saving preset with empty usersample.
[*]FIXED: In clipeditor - song mode, there were some hidden buttons still active.
[*]NEW: First Achievement for EA users
[/list]
